description:
About our brand and products:
Chems2U is an Australian-based supplier of high-quality laboratory research materials. We provide carefully sourced research compounds supported by full documentation, batch traceability, and Certificates of Analysis (COAs). Our focus is on consistency, transparency, and maintaining clear research-only positioning across all products and communications.

What makes us different:
We prioritise professionalism, reliability, and transparency. Every batch is documented, clearly labelled, and supported by verified testing. We maintain local Australian operations, fast dispatch, and responsive customer support. Our brand is built on trust, consistency, and long-term relationships with researchers and customers who value quality and accountability.

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates receive a unique referral link and optional discount code to share with their audience. You earn commission on qualifying completed orders made through your link. All referrals are automatically tracked through our affiliate system, and commissions are paid via PayPal once the payout threshold is reached. High-performing affiliates may be eligible for increased commission rates over time.

How to promote us:
Affiliates can promote Chems2U through social media, TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, online communities, or private networks. Many affiliates share their personal experience, educational content, or direct their audience to our website using their custom link or code. We provide guidance and support to help affiliates grow with us long-term.

Other information:
Chems2U is committed to ethical, transparent operations and maintains strict research-only positioning. We value long-term partnerships and support affiliates who align with our brand values of professionalism, consistency, and trust. Our goal is to build a reliable Australian brand that affiliates are proud to represent.

Chems2U Affiliate Terms & Conditions

By applying to and participating in the Chems2U Affiliate Program (“Program”), you (“Affiliate”) agree to the following terms.

1. Eligibility & Approval

Affiliate applications are subject to review and approval by Chems2U. We reserve the right to accept or decline applications at our discretion to ensure alignment with our values, compliance standards, and research-only positioning.

2. Research-Only Positioning

All products supplied by Chems2U are provided strictly for scientific and in-vitro research purposes only.
Affiliates must not make medical, therapeutic, diagnostic, human-use, or animal-use claims in any form of promotion.

3. Promotion Guidelines

Affiliates agree to:

  • Promote Chems2U in a truthful, professional, and compliant manner

  • Avoid misleading statements, exaggerated claims, or unverified outcomes

  • Not imply regulatory approval or suitability for human or animal use

  • Comply with applicable laws, advertising standards, and platform policies

Chems2U reserves the right to request changes or removal of non-compliant promotional content.

4. Referral Tracking & Commissions

Affiliates receive a unique referral link used to track qualifying orders.
Commissions are earned only on eligible purchases correctly attributed to the Affiliate’s link and are calculated according to the current commission structure.

Chems2U is not responsible for tracking issues caused by browser settings, ad blockers, or third-party interference.

5. Commission Payments

Commission payouts are processed once the minimum payout threshold has been met. Payments are made via PayPal, subject to affiliate account setup and verification.

Chems2U reserves the right to withhold, adjust, or reverse commissions for cancelled, refunded, fraudulent, or non-compliant orders.

6. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates must not:

  • Make prohibited health or medical claims

  • Engage in spam, deceptive marketing, or false representation

  • Bid on Chems2U brand terms in paid advertising

  • Represent themselves as Chems2U employees or agents

7. Termination

Chems2U may suspend or terminate affiliate participation at any time, with or without notice, for breach of these terms or for conduct deemed inconsistent with the Program’s intent.

8. Changes to Terms

Chems2U may update these Affiliate Terms at any time. Continued participation in the Program constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
